root_cause: Generic sharedPaths treated scripts/brain/*, config/* and docs/brain/* as executable shared changes. A control-plane-only autonomous optimizer PR therefore activated backend, portal, website and automation lanes, including Netlify build parity and browser verification despite no website or portal runtime delta.
prevention_rule: Assign known engineering control-plane files to explicit owned lanes before generic shared-path expansion, and classify the component registry as governance-only. Control-plane-only optimizer/calibration changes must not activate portal or website lanes unless another changed path has real runtime impact.
